objective: M5 actual-DPI gate at 200% (Phase 1 batch and Phase 2 live rows in Windows Sandbox)
scaleSource: User-set Windows display scale on the host (200%). The Sandbox guest is a remote session whose scale follows the host display; the guest reported 192 DPI before the runs and every DPI-bearing probe in the qualifying Phase 1 run reads dpi 192 (112 probes). No display setting was changed by any runner.
environment: Guest desktop 2117x639 DIP (working area 591 DIP tall); the Sample window was 1588x432 DIP, much shorter than the 150% session. C06/P2-SVG-03 narrow resizes request 760x860 DIP and are clamped by the desktop height.

firstRun.note: C15 Mermaid bottom scroll stuck at 1.35% (did not recur: P1-042); P1-016 opened no selection menu on a right-click over a selection handle (P1-040); V1-004 tap 1503.5 ms after release, a timing-envelope miss misreported as FAIL (harness).

secondRun.note: On the P1-040 fix: P1-016 then failed later, a long-press selected nothing after a double-tap (P1-041; live reproduction in p1-041-live-before.txt).

fixes.P1-040: Commit 50d14a39: selection handles forward mouse right-taps to the canvas right-tap path (touch and pen excluded). Red/green: p1-040-red.txt, p1-040-green.txt.
fixes.P1-041: Commit 7be71973: handles hand releases and cancels for contacts they do not own to the canvas pointer path, so a double-tap whose second release lands on a newly shown handle still ends its contact. Red/green: p1-041-red.txt, p1-041-green.txt; live before: p1-041-live-before.txt.
harness: Commit 50d14a39: V1-004 reports a post-tap envelope miss as UNVERIFIED, like its pre-tap checks.

Phase 2 visibility: HOSTED-03 wheels the hosted button into the window before tapping it, HIGHLIGHT-01 samples only the visible part of a code block taller than the window, and the guest scroll-range probe waits up to 3 s for geometry after ScrollIntoView (a scroll requested during relayout is deferred until layout commits). No oracle changed.

qualifyingRuns.note: Full Phase 1 batch with both investigation switches on the P1-040/P1-041 fixes (head adds only an evidence file after 7be71973; only restore-generated lock files differ). The 10 UNVERIFIED are the 9 standing receipt/tooling items and V1-004, whose guest setup took 1565.9 ms before the tap (outside its 1.5-second envelope).
Focused 200% run in which the V1-004 near-origin investigation completed inside its envelope and the nearby link activated.

Phase 2 live rows at 200%: 25 pass; the 5 UNVERIFIED are the standing notes (system High Contrast follow-up rows, WebP codec, and rows whose remaining items are qualified by separate receipts). P2-SVG-03, P2-HIGHLIGHT-01 and P2-HOSTED-03 failed on content outside the 432-DIP window.

P2-SVG-03, P2-HIGHLIGHT-01 and P2-HOSTED-03 pass at 200% with the visibility harness changes (HIGHLIGHT-01: 16 and 14 distinct colors; SVG-03: 68 of 81 sampled pixels changed Light to Dark; HOSTED-03 activated by keyboard and touch in both viewport modes).

screenshotReview: Reviewed the first run (65 screenshots), the P1-016 screenshots of the qualifying run and the Phase 2 run. No clipping, overlap, missing content or theme defect. Handles hang over the following line by design; montage screenshots show menus beside the window, not at their screen position.

openObservations.P1-042: C15 Mermaid bottom scroll stuck at 1.35% once (first run). Not reproduced in 4 later C15 runs at 200% or 36 in-guest probe iterations (immediate and delayed scrolls); cold-start probing was blocked because the Sample needs the harness launch path. Open, suspected only.
